case.title: List and Tech View show the asset's year, make and model
case.custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has an asset {Asset-A} with a year, make, model and unit number.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C11576 Asset Year, and {Asset-A} is a 2022 Freightliner M2, unit C11576-U1.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} on {Asset-A} is Approved.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-37700.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "List" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
case.custom_steps:
1. Read the Asset column of {Work-order-1}'s row.
  2. Click "Tech View" in the display switcher.
  3. Read the Asset column of {Work-order-1}'s row.
case.custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Asset column reads the year, then make, then model, for example "2022 Freightliner M2". The year is not missing.
  • Step 2: Tech View shows, with {Work-order-1} in Unassigned or its lead technician's group.
  • Step 3: the Asset column reads the same text as in List, year first, for example "2022 Freightliner M2".

The PRD keeps List as in production; Chris Ward's later ruling (quoted in SV-11576, 20 Oct 2026) adds the year to List's Asset column, in the same format as the Board View card. This case follows the later ruling.

Known problem (SV-11576, In Progress; it goes into this release if it fits, otherwise a fast follow, Chris Ward, Slack #fs-board-tech-view, 20 Oct 2026): the Asset column shows the make and model with no year. (1) If you see exactly that, mark this test Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, report it. (3) If the year shows, mark it Passed and tell the QA lead: the fix has shipped.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 71 (20 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 21 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, story SV-10048 (Story 5, Choose what is shown)

  • Story 5, optional fields: “asset (year/make/model)”

From: Jira SV-11576, “Work Orders List – Asset column never shows the asset's year” (Slavcho Mitrov, 20 Oct 2026), quoting Chris Ward on Slack, 20 Oct 2026, read 21 Oct 2026

  • Expected: “The same format as the Board card: year make model (Chris, Slack, 20 Oct 2026: "yes, in the same format as the Board card… Put it in this release if you can; if not, a fast follow is fine"). Tech View rows share this cell, so they show the year too.”

Not yet checked against a build.
